record.question: Which one of the following is a federal feature of the Indian Constitution?
options: Appointment of Judges of the High Court by the President
Distribution of powers between Union Government and State Government by the constitution
Appointment of Governor of the State by the President of India
record.explanation: The distribution of powers between the Union (central) government and State governments by the Constitution itself is the primary federal feature, establishing a dual government system.
